conventions.frame: window-origin ego frame at t0; x forward, y left, metres, clip-local

conventions.NOT_STRAIGHT: the ego's own future path leaves the same |lat| < 2.0 m corridor within the range claimed (the lead gap when there is a lead, else max_gap_m). conventions.NO_LABEL: no obstacle.offline for the clip, or the window leaves the labelled span. NEVER counted as free flow — that would manufacture empty road.
